{{Quote|A beautiful planet, Gatalenta. Its people are renowned for their long and steadfast support of the Jedi.|Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun|audio=DaeruunGatalenta.flac|<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />}}
'''Gatalenta''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. By the [[third Galactic War]], Gatalentans were known for their [[Gatalentan tea/Legends|tea]] and their long tradition of supporting the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Gatalenta was considered a beautiful planet by [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun]], a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gatalenta was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', specifically the<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> [[2018]]<ref name="JUS Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20181211-0|text='Jedi Under Siege' Update – Play Now!}}</ref> ''Jedi Under Siege'' update for the [[2016]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion. The planet is only mentioned if the player's character, known [[in-universe]] as the [[Alliance Commander]], is among the character classes originally aligned with the Republic.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> [[Gatalenta]] was originally introduced in the [[2016]] [[canon]] novel [[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']], written by [[Claudia Gray]].<ref name="Bloodline">[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']]</ref>
